name: table
label: Table
description: The table of the record to display attachments for

name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: The sys ID of the record to display attachments for

name: view
label: View
description: Specify view that attachment actions should try to resolve to

name: actionConfigId
label: Action Configuration ID
description: Sys ID for action configuration for getting attachment actions

name: isReadOnly
label: Is form read only?
description: Select to make attachments read only

name: isAttachmentUploadDisabled
label: Is uploading attachment disabled?
description: Select to prevent users from uploading attachments

name: showSkeletonLoader
label: Show skeleton loader
description: Select to show skeleton loader while loading attachments

name: isAttachmentEditDisabled
label: Is editing attachment disabled?
description: Select to prevent users from editing attachments

name: skipPreviewForUnsupportedFileTypes
label: Should skip preview for unsupported file types?
description: When this feature is enabled, attachments with unsupported file types will be directly downloaded without a preview

name: mode
label: Layout mode
description:
The layout in which the component is rendered. The current supported layouts are "full", "compact" and "custom". Full mode has a searchbar and a button for attachment sorting. Compact mode has smaller text and attachment card with no searchbar or attachment sorting button, 
Custom mode provides only an empty slot, allowing you to place any NDS element and map the `[Attachment] Attachment Upload Requested` event to trigger custom upload action.

name: refreshRequested
label: Refresh requested

timestamp.description: Timestamp of last record data fetch succeeded

description: Use this property to refresh the attachments component. The format will be a JSON object containing a timestamp of when the refresh was requested. i.e. {timestamp:Date.now()}

name: recordDisplayValue
label: Record display value
description: The record display value to show in the upload overlay

name: showUploadInstruction
label: Show upload instruction
description: None: No instructions display, Auto generate: Generate upload instructions based on file type and file size, Custom: Use custom instructions, requires custom instruction configuration

name: customUploadInstruction
label: Customised upload instruction to display
description: Custom upload instruction will be shown only when "Show Upload Instruction" = custom

name: attachmentHeader
label: Attachment header
description: The header text displayed in the Attachment header section.

name: maxFileSizeAllowed
label: Maximum file size allowed
description: File size entered here will be in MB, when left empty it will allow max file size of 1024 MB.

name: allowedFileTypes
label: Allowed file types
description: Enter file types separated by commas. If left empty, all allowed file types will be supported.

name: primaryUpfrontAction
label: Primary upfront action
description: Select an action to be shown upfront on the attachment card.

name: isMultiFileUpload
label: Allow multiple file upload.
description: when unchecked, only single files will be allowed.

name: showMultiDelete
label: Show multidelete option.
description: Show multidelete option on the attachment header.

name: showCompactModeDropZone
label: Show file drop area
description: Shows the file-drop area when enabled

name: previewModalOnUpload
label: Show preview modal during upload
description: when unchecked, the file preview modal will not appear during upload.

name: nowDsDomainId
label: Domain Id
description: Id of the domain of the record

name: nowDsDomainScope
label: Domain Scope
description: Domain scope through which the record is being viewed

name: nowDsRecordId
label: Domain Record Id
description: Id of record in the domain

name: nowDsRecordTable
label: Domain Record Table
description: Table of the record in the domain
